main.description: RebirthGate — organism rebirth path (悔い改め / 輪廻). Equivalent to (a) dissolve old organism with full asset forfeiture + social-graph severance + delegated-AI wipe, and (b) emerge a new organism with a fresh santana_root that cannot claim continuity (Karma.lean anatman_unique_santana). Edges from the prior organism persist in network unchanged (Karma.lean N2). zk-SNARK non-linkability proof is OUT OF SCOPE for Phase K0 (deferred to Phase K1) — Phase K0 enforces non-linkability by protocol commitment only. Symmetric across individual / collective organism.

did.description: DID of organism to dissolve (must be currently active)

newDid.description: DID of new organism to emerge. MUST have an independently-generated santana_root (key derivation MUST NOT use any material from `did`). Server checks santana_root inequality but cannot verify independence without zk-SNARK (Phase K1).

membershipDepsRootCid.description: IPFS CID of membership/contexts snapshot to commit at dissolution moment

consentSignature.description: Caller signature over (did, newDid, ts_ms) attesting voluntary rebirth (Karma.lean N3 commitment)
